decisive_source_correction.timing: After all four generators; before any technical screening or external search

L1.issue: Form-feed-aware splitlines selected chart ticks instead of supporting prose. Integrity did not imply entailment.
L1.correct_quote:
When the covisibility ratio drops below 20%, we observe a sharp increase in both translation and
 rotation errors. This degradation occurs because the distribution of matched points becomes non-
 uniform across the image. This non-uniformity causes PnP to overfit to specific image regions,
 creating an underdetermined problem that compromises localization accuracy.
L1.causal_limit: Spatial concentration and rank deficiency remain explanations, not separately isolated empirical causes.

decisive_source_correction.L2: Aggregate populations can differ (17/496 vs17/423 in-place/out-place available test samples); equal rounded matching error is not identical matches or a controlled DSM-only intervention.
decisive_source_correction.L3: Views are Google Earth renderings and Recall@1 is patch retrieval under basemap/IoU criteria, not real-flight pose. Residual error has no established causal partition.

limitation: Byte/quote linkage only; semantic validity independently checked. The original L1 manifest is intentionally retained but not supporting evidence.
